 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/42/2020/037 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "WTP Augmentation - Delhi Pkg-37" (water treatment), awarded to M/
 s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 27 Aug 2020 at a gross executed value of INR 6.75 Cr (Rupees 6.75 Crore Only).
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Sanjay Joshi. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
